derivation: from H3527 (כָּבַר) in the sense of covering; (compare H4345 (מַכְבֵּר))

occurrences.text: And it came to pass on the morrow, that he took a thick cloth, and dipped it in water, and spread it on his face, so that he died: and Hazael reigned in his stead.
